meta.source: lab/rooms_corpus_extract.js and lab/rooms_corpus_stats.js on compact.json (2,128 builds)
meta.likedRule: top quarter of vanilla builds by votes (votes >= 10), ties by downloads
meta.roomRule: reader room (lib/decorate.js readLevel) with half or more of its floor under a roof, 4 to 400 m2, vanilla build, no mod piece inside; floor furniture: pivot under 0.5 m over the floor

fields.tableSets: per dining table prefab: seats are floor seats and thrones whose pivot is within 1.25 m of the table box (each seat to its nearest table). seatsPerTable over all tables, seatsPerSeatedTable over tables with one or more; seatPrefabsPerSet: distinct seat prefabs at one table; matchedShare: sets whose seats are all one prefab; matchedFamilyShare: sets whose seats all share the table's material family; position: head (beyond an end), side, corner; gapSide/gapHead: m from the seat pivot to the table box; sideOffset: m from the table middle line to a side seat pivot; turnBySeat: [turn in 15 degree steps between the seat yaw and the bearing to the table, count] (the most common turn is the facing convention of that prefab); combos: seat prefab sets with counts
fields.beds: per bed prefab: head is local -z; near: [position: type, share of beds]; positions behind head, beside head, beside foot, foot, on; names: [position: prefab, count]; chestAtFoot, sideTable (a table, chest, barrel, crate or building piece beside the head), lightBeside, rugUnder: shares
fields.work: per station (forge, smelter, workbench, ...): backToWall share (pivot under 0.6 m from a wall face); near: prefabs within 4 m: share of stations with one or more, count per station, distance quantiles (m), where (in front, behind, beside in the station frame)
fields.bars: counters: building pieces inside a room with tops 0.8 to 1.4 m over the floor (no 2x2 floors), joined into a run 2 m or longer and at most 0.8 m between part pivots across; wallBehind: m from the counter line to the wall on its nearer side; clearBehind: m from the counter to the wall or to floor furniture standing behind it; behind: prefabs behind the counter (count of bars); seatsInFront: seats within 1.6 m in front
fields.custom: building pieces standing inside rooms (custom furniture): piece, height band of its top (seat height 0.25-0.7 m, table height 0.7-1.25, shelf height 1.25-2.4), the nearest furniture type within 1.2 m, pieces, rooms, builds, room kinds, one example in a liked build (world x, y, z)
